title: Appointment form that opens WhatsApp with pre-filled booking details

requirements.summary: Add an Appointment form section on the landing page that opens WhatsApp (wa.me) with all entered booking details pre-filled (no backend storage).
acceptanceCriteria: A new, clearly labeled section is available on the page for booking (English-only user-facing text).
The form includes at minimum: Customer Name, Phone Number, Service (select from existing services), Area/Location, Preferred Date, Preferred Time, and Notes/Message.
Submitting the form opens WhatsApp to https://wa.me/918000262644 with a URL-encoded pre-filled message that includes all entered fields in a readable format.
The feature works on mobile and desktop (on desktop it opens web.whatsapp.com via the wa.me link as supported by the platform/browser).
No data is persisted to the backend; no Motoko changes are required for this feature.

file_operations.description: Create a new landing-page section (id="appointment") containing the Appointment form UI and submit behavior that builds a URL-encoded message and opens the wa.me link in a new tab/window. Use the shadcn-ui component library (e.g., Card patterns already used in the app) to keep styling consistent. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small utility that formats the booking details into a readable message string and returns a fully assembled https://wa.me/918000262644 URL with URL-encoded text (encodeURIComponent).
Export a stable list of service options derived from the existing services shown on the page (for reuse in the Appointment form 'Service' select) without changing the existing Services UI output.
Wire the new <AppointmentFormSection /> into the existing landing page flow so it is reachable via scrolling (and not an orphan component).

requirements.summary: Add client-side validation to the Appointment form with concise English inline errors for missing/invalid fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Required fields cannot be submitted while invalid; validation messages are shown near the corresponding inputs.
Validation does not block the rest of the page or break existing CTAs/links.
Error messages are English-only and concise.

file_operations.description: Implement client-side validation (required fields, phone number format) and inline, non-intrusive English error messages per field; prevent submit until valid while keeping the rest of the page interactive. Use shadcn-ui styling conventions where applicable for error states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the message formatter safely handles optional fields (e.g., Notes) and uses consistent labeling/order so the WhatsApp pre-filled message remains readable.

requirements.summary: Add a prominent, visible access point from the current landing flow that scrolls to the Appointment form without changing any existing CTA destinations.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing CTAs and their destinations remain unchanged (tel:+918000262644, https://wa.me/918000262644, Instagram link, and Google Business Profile link).
A new link/button scrolls to (or otherwise reveals) the appointment form section and is visible on both mobile and desktop.
All new visible text remains English-only.

file_operations.description: Add an additional prominent link/button (English-only label) that scrolls to the Appointment section (href="#appointment") while leaving existing CTA destinations exactly unchanged.
Add a navigation link (visible on desktop nav) to the Appointment form section (href="#appointment") without altering the existing Call/WhatsApp/Instagram CTA destinations.
Optionally add a quick link to the Appointment section (href="#appointment") in existing footer navigation areas for additional discoverability, without changing any existing CTA destinations.
